detail.description:
Location

Here, you’ll be enjoying yourself all the time. Four Seasons Resort Dubai at Jumeirah Beach Hotel is located in Dubai. This resort is located in 9 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the resort — Jumeirah Beach, Jumeira Open Beach and Business Bay.

At the resort

You can stop by the bar. It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. The resort cafe is a nice place to have a snack. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available.

Specially for tourists who travel by car, there’s a parking zone. The beauty and wellness services: a massage room, a sauna, a steam bath and a spa center. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center, a gym, a table tennis area and a diving club. You won’t be bored as at the resort you will find a picnic area and a barbeque area.

Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. Children will be happy, there is a playroom for them. Want to have an excursion? Consult the tour assistance desk of the resort. The staff of the resort will order a transfer for you.

Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. There are other services available for the guests of the resort. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, private check-in and check-out, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the resort speaks English, Spanish, German, Russian, French and Korean.

Room amenities

In the room, there is an alarm clock, a shower, a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.description:
Location

Four Seasons Dubai International Financial Centre Hotel is located in 6 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel — Emirates Towers, Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. Have a cup of coffee in the cafe and, who knows, maybe it’s going to be the best one in the city. Free Wi-Fi is available on the territory. Ask for more information when checking in.

The beauty and wellness services: a massage room, a sauna, a spa center and a recreation club. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center and a gym. Swimming fans are going to enjoy a pool and an outdoor pool. You can arrange a business meeting, a board meeting, and even a job interview as there is a business center.

Want to have an excursion? Consult the tour assistance desk of the hotel. For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you. Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, private check-in and check-out, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge.

The staff of the hotel will be happy to talk to you in English, Spanish, Italian, German, Russian and French.

Room amenities

Guests will find the following in the room: an alarm clock, a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

Location

Grand Hyatt Dubai Hotel is located in the center of Dubai. Guests can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Dubai Dolphinarium, Dubai Creek and GGICO.

At the hotel

The hotel offers a 5-star city resort experience featuring a 20,000 square meter waterpark where guests can enjoy the blend of adventure and relaxation.

Blending family-friendly facilities with authentic Arabian charm, this iconic 37-acre urban resort, surrounded by lush landscaped gardens. The hotel features 710 spacious and elegantly designed rooms and suites, 12 dining destinations, an indoor lap pool, Dubai’s largest outdoor pool, as well as a shaded toddler pool for little guests.

Spanning 20,000 square meters, the Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark features 16 exhilarating rides and attractions designed to delight the entire family. From thrilling waterslides and a lazy river to the region’s first Triple Flow Rider, there is something for every adventure seeker and sun-soaker. For those seeking exclusivity and relaxation, the wave pool with pristine sand, complete with private cabanas.

Make the most of the stay with a variety of family-friendly activities. Kids will love meeting and feeding the ducks.

Location

Hyatt Centric Jumeirah Dubai Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 11 km from the city center. Guests can take a walk and explore the neighborhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: La Mer Beach, Jumeira Open Beach and World Trade Centre.

At the hotel

Guests can stop by the restaurant. Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help to stay on-line. If guests travel by car, there’s a free parking zone. The following services are also available for the guests: a spa center.

Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center. Guests can arrange a business meeting, a board meeting, and even a job interview as there is a conference hall. To book an excursion, guests can consult the tour assistance desk of the hotel. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, press, a safe-deposit box and a concierge.

Room amenities

The room is decorated and has what guests need to have a rest after a long eventful day. There is a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. The room equipment depends on its category.
